title: Moros y Cristianos (Black Beans and Rice)
summary: Black beans simmered with aromatics, then baked with rice, a cumin-oregano pepper base and their own cooking liquid.

ingredients.item: dried black beans, soaked overnight in plenty of water
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Drain the soaked beans and simmer with the water, pepper piece, onion piece, crushed garlic, bay and the bean salt, covered, 30-40 min until just tender.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Discard the aromatics, drain the beans and keep 590 ml of the cooking liquid (top up with water if short). Heat the oven to 180 °C.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Heat the oil in the casserole and fry the chopped pepper and onion with the oregano, cumin and tomato paste over medium heat 10-15 min until soft and starting to brown; stir in the chopped garlic for 1 min.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir in the rice for 30 s, then add the beans, kept liquid, vinegar and the rice salt and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover and bake 30 min until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fluff, rest 5 min, then top with spring onion and coriander and serve with lime.

tips: Keep the bean liquid; it colours and seasons the rice.
Bake rather than simmer for evenly cooked rice.
Serve with lime to brighten it.
storage: Cool quickly and keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
